stories.title: Hamas Releases Four Female Israeli Soldiers Under Gaza Cease-Fire Deal
stories.summary: Hamas released four female Israeli soldiers under the Gaza ceasefire agreement. They were the second group of hostages freed since the multiphase deal took effect, raising hopes that the agreement could lead to a lasting end to the war.

stories.title: Shippers Wary of Red Sea Routes Despite Houthi Pledge to End Targeting
stories.summary: The world's three largest container-shipping operators remain wary of returning to Red Sea routes despite a Houthi pledge to stop targeting vessels. They say instability in Gaza and wider regional tensions continue to make the route dangerous.
